sections.advice: This High point near Seonghwan → Scenic stretch near Hwaseong-si stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Scenic stretch near Hwaseong-si → Photo stop near Gyodong is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

safetyMarkers.note: Respect posted limits and assume enforcement near villages, viewpoints and main-road joins.

legend-medellin-las-palmas-and-oriente-l.story: curated scenic road. Andes, reservoirs, mountain towns. From Medellín it runs 112 km to Medellín; allow about 2 h 02 of riding. It goes by way of Envigado, Retiro and Guatapé. The highest point is about 2,550 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Medellin Las Palmas and Oriente Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 11 km this is Medellin Las Palmas and Oriente Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
